Inside that loop, when a matching credential is not found in this.calendarCredentials, it performs an awaited prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } }) for that reference. This creates a classic N+1 query pattern (one DB round-trip per calendar reference during update/reschedule) which is a performance/scalability concern but not a direct correctness defect shown by the diff.
